component.name: JimEzRestart
component.summary: Restart the desktop, the kernel or the whole system
重启桌面、当前内核或整个系统

description.p: JimEzRestart is a small control panel for the different ways of restarting a Linux system.

ul.li: Restart the desktop shell through its systemd user unit or a command.
Hot reboot: restart the user space with systemctl soft-reboot.
Warm reboot: boot a kernel with kexec, either through systemd or natively.
Cold reboot: a standard reboot, or an emergency SysRq hard reboot.

description.p: Operations that need root go through a fixed, audited helper script via polkit.
